backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to related files, components, and tests.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing predefined summaries of multiple frontend source files.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment guide outlining production build, verification steps, and deployment process.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining OKLCH color tokens and light/dark theme variables.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML template loading the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/scripts/verify-assets.ts: Node script verifying required static assets exist before production build.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React layout composing header, sections, and footer within an error boundary.
frontend/src/components/ContactForm.tsx: Validated contact form with field-level errors and simulated async submission.
frontend/src/components/ProductionErrorB: React error boundary that displays a fallback UI and reload option on failures.
frontend/src/components/sections/AboutSe: Renders an about section with marketing text and value cards using icons.
frontend/src/components/sections/Contact: Displays contact info, sanitized phone link, and a contact form in a two-column layout.
frontend/src/components/sections/HeroSec: Hero section with background image, headline content, CTAs, and smooth-scroll behavior.
frontend/src/components/sections/Service: Shows a grid of service cards with icons and descriptions from marketing content.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Footer with branding, navigation links, social icons, and attribution.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Responsive site header with logo, navigation, scroll-based styling, and mobile menu toggling.
frontend/src/content/brandAssets.ts: Exports centralized paths for logo and hero images used across the app.
frontend/src/content/marketingCopy.ts: Provides static marketing text for hero, about, services, and contact sections.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, refetching on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication using AuthClient, exposing identity, login, logout, and status states.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder hook file prepared for future backend query integrations using useActor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and custom OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider, then renders App.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, fonts, animations, and enabling plugins like typography and container queries.
frontend/tsconfig.node.json: TypeScript configuration for Node-related files, including module resolution and build settings.
frontend/vite.config.ts: Configures Vite with React plugin, path aliasing, build output options, and dev server settings.
project_state.json: Tracks project metadata, existing features, and deployment-related requirements for the app.
